offering_description.value: Sells furniture, home décor, bedding, and kitchenware to consumers and trade customers. It designs much of its assortment, sources most products from suppliers, and sells through websites, stores, and trade sales teams.

primary_products.value: Indoor and outdoor furniture; cookware and kitchen tools; bedding and bath textiles; lighting and home décor; specialty foods

primary_services.value: Interior design and space planning; product personalization

customer_segment.value: B2C: Consumers furnishing, decorating, and equipping their homes; B2B: Interior designers, architects, hospitality operators, and commercial property developers

end_markets.value: Residential home furnishings; home cooking and entertaining; hospitality; commercial interiors

revenue_model.value: product sales: Furniture, home accessories, kitchen goods, and merchandise for trade and contract customers; licensing or royalties: International franchise rights for retail concepts

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Sells home furnishings and kitchen goods to consumers and trade customers; brand owner: Designs proprietary goods made by suppliers for consumers and trade customers; OEM / manufacturer: Makes some upholstered furniture from purchased materials for sale through its retail brands

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, and Australia, with franchise markets in Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Furniture, bedding and bath, lighting and décor, kitchenware, and specialty foods

distribution_channels.value: online: Company-operated retail websites; own locations: Company-operated specialty stores and outlets; direct sales: Trade and contract sales teams for design and commercial accounts; partners / resellers: International franchise operators
distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Furniture and household goods safety under U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission rules
